review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped for uses of the two definitions. cubicThetaScalarHeightCutoff and cubicThetaScalarHeightHigh are tsums over CubicThetaBottomRow of an if-then-else on height ≤ 1 and height > 1. The only generic alternative is writing the sums with Set.indicator or a subtype tsum. That would be a stylistic rewrite, not a competing version of a Mathlib concept, and both definitions are used in downstream files (the Rankin kernel, the height seed and the seed pairing). The lemmas are file-specific. I found no independent Mathlib declaration that this file duplicates. I did not examine other files in the OAI project for duplication among themselves.
